a.title: Don't like your Facebook feed? Meta wants to know what you want to see instead

b.lede: Facebook's new "Your Algorithm" feature will let you directly add and manage topics you want to see in your feed and Facebook Reels. Meta says your recommendations "respond right away" after you make updates using the new feature by hitting "interested" or "not interested" for different topics.
